description: Speeds up busy solar systems: wrecks that are not moving are left out of the per-tick movement planning (which otherwise grows with the square of the object count), and item-type lookups by name, done for every NPC wreck, are remembered. No gameplay change.

fields.label: Skip resting wrecks
fields.description: Leave wrecks that are not moving out of the movement planning of the system's tick. A wreck being tractored or pushed is still moved normally. Default: on.

fields.label: Remember item lookups by name
fields.description: Remember the result of looking up an item type by name (done for every destroyed NPC to pick its wreck). Default: on.
